names.title: 99 Names of Allah
names.subtitle: Al-Asma' al-Husna, the Most Beautiful Names, with their meanings and where they are mentioned in the Quran and Sunnah.
names.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah has ninety-nine Names, one-hundred less one; and he who memorized them all by heart will enter Paradise.”
names.aboutText: The number ninety-nine and this virtue are authentic (Sahih al-Bukhari). The names themselves, in this order, come from the list in {source}, which counts “Allah” as the first name. Its chain is graded weak, and many scholars hold that the list was added by a narrator; other narrations differ slightly, and Allah's names are not limited to ninety-nine.
names.refsText: {n} of the 99 names link to a verse of the Quran or a hadith that mentions the name, or the action it describes.
names.review: The transliterations and meanings are written by our team and are awaiting review by a scholar.
names.searchPlaceholder: Name, meaning or number, e.g. Ar-Rahman or 20

qibla.title: Qibla direction
qibla.subtitle: The direction of the Kaaba from where you are, with a compass and a map.
qibla.choose: Choose your location to find the Qibla.
qibla.bearingHelp: Turn clockwise from true north by this angle to face the Kaaba.
qibla.compassLabel: Compass. The gold mark shows the Qibla.
qibla.compassUnsupported: This device has no compass, or the browser doesn't share it. Use the angle or the map instead.
qibla.tips: Hold your phone flat, away from metal and magnets. If the direction looks wrong, move the phone in a figure 8 a few times to calibrate it. A compass is never exact, so check it against the map.
qibla.noCompass: Without a compass, the dial shows north at the top.
qibla.mapHelp: The line runs from your location to the Kaaba. Zoom in to line it up with nearby streets or buildings.
qibla.mapPrivacy: Map images come from OpenStreetMap, so its servers see which area you are viewing.
qibla.mapLabel: Map with a line from your location to the Kaaba
